text:
ellie_csm: Heads-up team 1: Skylark pilot - need to lock a ‘Kickoff + Lab’ runbook. They9re a 3-seat pilot, requested 60m kickoff + 45m hands-on lab. Preflight shows missing network whitelist and no example prompts yet. Renewal review in ~5 weeks (possible red flag).

devin_se: I can take the kickoff (60m) Wed 2026-06-09 10:00 PT. Can run architecture + live deploy. Need assistance for lab exercises (45m) - prefer to split into two 22m stations instead of single 45m.

mina_pm: Good idea to split labs. Customer timezone: BST and SGT users. Suggest offering one EMEA-friendly slot and one APAC-friendly slot for the lab rehearsals. Also add a 15m internal prebrief with product for the migration checklist.

ellie_csm: Proposed schedule (tentative):
```
- Kickoff (60m): Wed 2026-06-09 10:00 PT / 18:00 BST
- Lab A (22m): Fri 2026-06-11 16:30 BST (EMEA)
- Lab B (22m): Mon 2026-06-14 09:30 SGT (APAC)
- Internal host rehearsal (15m): 30m before kickoff
```

ben_solutions: I9ll cover the lab exercises and build two short troubleshooting cheatsheets. Need sample prompts, sample config YAML, and the customer9s CIDR ranges for whitelisting by EOD Tue.

devin_se: Also want to capture one or two migration-risk indicators during the session. We should add a quick renewal-signal check at the end: 3-question poll (value met?, blockers?, renewal likelihood).

mina_pm: I'll add a slide "Cost & Ops controls" and a one-slide ROI calc using conservative token assumptions. Call out autoscaling behavior and expected avg latency.

ellie_csm: Action items:
- ellie_csm: send preflight checklist & ask for sample prompts + CIDR (today)
- ben_solutions: create lab exercises + cheatsheets (Wed)
- devin_se: draft architecture + ROI slide (Tue)
- mina_pm: create poll template + host rehearsal invite (Tue)
- ops-bot: please schedule HubSpot followup survey 24h after kickoff

ops-bot: HubSpot sequence queued: Skylark Kickoff NPS+followup for thread 1769990001. :white_check_mark:

ben_solutions: Calendar invites - I'll include Zoom link + recording enabled. Also adding a note in the invite about required ports: 443, 8443 and SSH (22) for any agent installs.

ellie_csm: Please tag the invite with account metadata: account_tier:pilot, renewal_window:5w, prework:pending. Helps CS triage during the session.

devin_se: Small ask: can someone create a short Loom that walks through the preflight checklist? That reduces friction.

ellie_csm: I'll record a 3-min Loom and attach to invites.

mina_pm: If the customer can't make proposed slots, fallback to next-week same-day times. Also plan a follow-up office hour 1 week after the lab to reduce churn risk.

ben_solutions: Noted. Will prepare recording clips of the lab steps (<=3min each) and upload to shared enablement folder after session.

ellie_csm: Great. I'll confirm with the customer and update here. If they accept, we'll run internal rehearsal 30m before kickoff and aim to close prework next 48h. :thumbsup:

mina_pm: One more: include a one-line "what success looks like" in the invite (eg: "able to run inference end-to-end with expected latency <500ms for 512 tokens"). That focuses conversation on measurable outcomes.

ellie_csm: Adding that now. Will circle back after confirmation.
